note: Alberta Parks campground beside Three Point Creek, 6 km W of Millarville on Hwy 549, about an hour from Calgary. Sites are in spruce woods south of the highway; a base for hiking, biking and riding in the Sheep Valley. Bring drinking water (the hand pump is for fires only); firewood sold at the manager's site, the firewood truck and McLean Creek's store. --Claude
